headerDisplay: Connect Nimbio cellular smart gates to Apple HomeKit. Create an API key in the Nimbio portal (account key for personal gates, community key for managed communities).
footerDisplay: Use a `nimbio_test_…` key while verifying setup (opens are simulated). Switch to `nimbio_live_…` for real gate control.

name.title: Name
name.description: Platform name shown in Homebridge logs.

apiKey.title: Nimbio API Key
apiKey.description: Bearer API key from the Nimbio portal (`nimbio_live_…` or `nimbio_test_…`). Account keys open your latches; community keys can also poll gate status.

accessoryType.title: Accessory Type
accessoryType.description: Garage Door is the usual HomeKit control for gates. Switch fires open when turned On, then flips back Off.

latchIds.title: Latch IDs
latchIds.description: Optional. Only expose these latch IDs. Leave empty to expose every latch on the key.

latchNames.title: Latch Name Overrides
latchNames.description: Optional map of latch ID → HomeKit display name.

namePrefix.title: Name Prefix
namePrefix.description: Optional prefix added to each discovered latch name.

autoCloseSeconds.title: Auto-Close Seconds
autoCloseSeconds.description: When no sense line is available, how long HomeKit keeps the gate shown as Open after a successful pulse before returning to Closed.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Status Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Community keys only. How often to poll gate-status. Set 0 to disable.

pulseOnClose.title: Pulse on Close
pulseOnClose.description: If enabled, asking HomeKit to close also sends a Nimbio open (for operators that toggle on each pulse).

openNote.title: Open Note
openNote.description: Optional note stored with each open in Nimbio access logs.

timeoutSeconds.title: API Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Nimbio open calls wait for the cellular box to confirm (~15–18s). Keep this above that.

baseUrl.title: API Base URL
baseUrl.description: Optional override. Leave blank for production (https://api.nimbio.com).
